name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on bench with feet on the floor
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width
Unrack and lower the bar to mid-chest
Press the bar back up to lockout

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench holding dumbbells at chest level
Press dumbbells up until arms are extended
Lower slowly back to starting position
tips: Keep a slight arch in your lower back
Don't let dumbbells drift too far apart

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Press dumbbells from chest to lockout
tips: Don't set the incline too high or shoulders take over

name: Push-ups
instructions: Push back up to starting position

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Stand between cable pulleys set at chest height
Bring handles together in front of chest
tips: Maintain a slight bend in elbows throughout

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells above chest
Lower dumbbells out to sides with slight bend in elbows
Bring dumbbells back together above chest
tips: Don't go too heavy - focus on the stretch

name: Chest Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars and lean forward slightly
Lower body until upper arms are parallel to floor
Push back up to starting position
tips: Lean forward to target chest more

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit in machine with back flat against pad
Press forward until arms are extended
tips: Good for beginners learning the pressing motion

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge at hips with barbell hanging
Pull barbell to lower chest/upper abs

name: Pull-ups
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip
Pull body up until chin clears bar
tips: Engage lats, don't just use arms

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull bar down to upper chest

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at cable row with feet on platform

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on bench
Row dumbbell from floor to hip
tips: Keep back flat and parallel to floor

name: Face Pulls
instructions: Set cable at face height with rope attachment
Pull rope towards face, spreading hands apart
Squeeze rear delts at the end
tips: Great for posture and shoulder health

name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, barbell over mid-foot
Hinge at hips and grip bar
Drive through heels to stand up

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with barbell at shoulder height
tips: Press slightly back at the top

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height

name: Lateral Raises
instructions: Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor
tips: Lead with elbows, slight bend in arms

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Bend forward at hips holding dumbbells
Raise arms out to sides squeezing rear delts
tips: Keep a slight bend in elbows

name: Front Raises
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs
Raise one or both arms to shoulder height

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding barbell with underhand grip
Curl bar up to shoulder level

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms forward
tips: Can alternate arms or do both together

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other)

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at cable machine with bar/rope at chest height
Push down until arms are fully extended

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands
Lower behind head by bending elbows

name: Skull Crushers
instructions: Lie on bench holding EZ bar above chest
Lower bar toward forehead by bending elbows

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Squat down until thighs are parallel or below
tips: Keep chest up and core braced

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Squat down by pushing hips back

name: Leg Press
tips: Don't lock knees at the top
Don't go too deep if you have knee issues

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at hips pushing them back
Lower bar along legs until stretch in hamstrings

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs

name: Lunges
instructions: Step forward into a lunge position
Push off front foot to return
tips: Front knee doesn't go past toes

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place rear foot on bench behind you
Lower until front thigh is parallel
tips: Keep most weight on front foot

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in machine with pads on shins

name: Calf Raises
instructions: Stand on edge of step or flat ground
Rise up on toes as high as possible
tips: Pause at the top for maximum contraction

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on ground with upper back against bench
tips: Squeeze glutes hard at the top

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat

name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Attach ankle strap to low cable
tips: Don't arch back - use glute to move leg

name: Plank
instructions: Get into push-up position on forearms
tips: Don't let hips sag or pike up

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Raise legs until parallel with floor or higher

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet off floor
tips: Can hold a weight for added resistance

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel in front of cable with rope behind head
tips: Focus on contracting abs, not pulling with arms

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on back with hands behind head
Bring opposite elbow to knee alternating sides

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back with arms extended up and knees at 90 degrees
Extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously
tips: Keep lower back pressed into floor

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Drive knees toward chest alternating rapidly
tips: Keep core tight, don't bounce hips

name: Burpees
instructions: Stand, then squat down and place hands on floor
Jump feet forward and jump up
tips: Modify by stepping instead of jumping if needed

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulders
Hinge at hips, swing kettlebell between legs
Drive hips forward to swing kettlebell to chest height
tips: Power comes from hips, not arms

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Jump over rope with small hops
Land softly on balls of feet
tips: Use wrists to turn rope, not arms

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Sit on rower with feet strapped in
Drive with legs then pull handle to chest
tips: Power comes from legs first, then back, then arms

name: Foam Rolling - Full Body
instructions: Pause on tight spots for 20-30 seconds
Cover quads, hamstrings, IT band, calves, back
tips: Don't roll directly on joints or bones

name: Dynamic Stretching Routine
tips: Great as a warm-up before any workout

name: Yoga Sun Salutation
tips: Focus on breathing with each movement

name: Shrugs
tips: Don't roll shoulders, straight up and down

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Walk with good posture for distance or time
Keep shoulders back and core tight
tips: Use straps if grip fails before muscles

name: Box Jumps
instructions: Jump onto box landing softly with both feet
tips: Start with a lower box and progress

name: Step-ups
instructions: Stand in front of bench or step
Drive through heel to stand on top
tips: Can hold dumbbells for added resistance

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar with hands shoulder-width or narrower
Press back up focusing on triceps

name: Diamond Push-ups
instructions: Get in push-up position with hands close forming a diamond shape

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell above chest
Lower dumbbell behind head with slight bend in elbows
tips: Feel the stretch in lats and chest

name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with wide stance, toes pointed out
Hold dumbbell or kettlebell between legs
tips: Great for inner thigh and glutes

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Lean against wall with feet 2 feet away
Slide down until thighs are parallel to floor

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on side propped on forearm

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously
tips: Keep back flat and core braced

name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place bringing knees to hip height

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand with feet together, arms at sides
Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with dumbbells in front of face, palms facing you
Reverse the motion on the way down

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand beside cable with handle in far hand

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle barbell anchored at one end
Row the free end up to chest

name: Reverse Fly Machine
instructions: Grip handles and push arms back

name: Incline Bicep Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench with arms hanging
tips: Great for long head of biceps

name: Tricep Dips (Bench)
instructions: Place hands on bench behind you
tips: Don't go too deep if shoulders hurt

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: Sit in leg press with toes on bottom of platform

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Stand in hack squat machine with shoulders under pads
Squat down until thighs are parallel

name: Good Mornings
instructions: Hinge at hips pushing them back
tips: Use light weight until form is perfect

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Sit in machine with pads on outer thighs

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold band at shoulder height with arms extended
Pull band apart by squeezing shoulder blades

name: Resistance Band Squat
instructions: Stand on band with feet shoulder-width
Squat down and back up against resistance
tips: Band adds resistance at the top

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor band behind you at chest height
tips: Good home alternative to bench press

name: Resistance Band Row
instructions: Sit with legs extended, band around feet

name: Chin-ups
instructions: Hang from bar with underhand grip
Pull up until chin clears bar

name: Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead
Simultaneously raise arms, chest, and legs off floor

name: Donkey Kicks
instructions: Keeping knee bent, lift one leg up

name: Fire Hydrants
instructions: Keeping knee bent, lift leg out to the side

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit with forearms on thighs, wrists over knees
Curl dumbbells up using only wrists
tips: Can do palms up and palms down versions

name: Upright Row
instructions: Hold barbell with narrow grip in front of thighs
Pull bar up along body to chin
tips: Wide grip is easier on shoulders

name: Decline Push-ups
instructions: Place feet on bench, hands on floor

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Rotate torso pulling cable diagonally down
tips: Rotate from the hips and core, not arms

name: Pike Push-ups
instructions: Get in push-up position with hips high in pike position
Lower head toward floor by bending elbows

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hang under a bar or table at waist height
Pull chest to bar keeping body straight

name: V-ups
instructions: Touch toes at the top forming V shape

name: Reverse Lunges
instructions: Step one foot backward into lunge
Push off back foot to return
tips: Easier on knees than forward lunges

name: Ab Rollout
instructions: Kneel with ab wheel or barbell

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Keep legs straight, raise them to 90 degrees
tips: Place hands under lower back for support if needed

name: Single-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding dumbbell
Hinge forward while extending free leg behind

name: Bench Dips
instructions: Place hands on bench behind you, feet on floor
Lower body by bending elbows to 90 degrees

name: Hip Circle Walk
tips: Keep band tension at all times

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Bend over with torso parallel to floor
Row barbell from floor to lower chest explosively
Lower bar back to floor each rep
tips: Reset each rep from the floor

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Place one end of barbell in corner or landmine attachment
Hold other end at shoulder height
tips: Can do single or both arms
Easier on shoulders than overhead press

name: Dumbbell Snatch
instructions: Start with dumbbell between feet in squat position
Explosively extend and pull dumbbell overhead

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on hands and feet with knees slightly off ground
Crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie on back holding kettlebell with one arm extended
Stand up through a series of controlled movements
Reverse to return to lying position
tips: Master the movement with no weight first

name: Dumbbell Clean and Press
instructions: Clean dumbbells to shoulders with a slight jump
tips: Use hip drive for the clean portion

name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Hold rope ends at hip height
tips: Generate power from legs and hips

name: Seated Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: Sit in seated calf raise machine
tips: Full range of motion is key

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at preacher bench with upper arms on pad

name: Kickback
instructions: Bend forward with upper arm parallel to floor
